note: The ten queries the citation-edge method CANNOT produce, held separately so
a derived query and a hand-built one are never mistaken for each other.
HINDI — five, and the corpus assumption behind them was WRONG.
LCC_MASTER_PLAN A1.3 says 'Hindi judgments exist in the corpus
(judgments.language = hi). Confirm there are enough to build 5 real
queries; if not, that is a finding, not a reason to write English queries
and call them Hindi.' Counted on 8 Aug 2026: ZERO of 38,341 judgments carry
language = 'hi'. A Hindi query set over a Hindi corpus is impossible today.
That is the finding. What is built instead is not a workaround, it is the
case that actually occurs: a Hindi-speaking advocate types a Hindi question
and the authority they need is an English Supreme Court judgment. Every
Supreme Court judgment is delivered in English. So these five measure
CROSS-LINGUAL retrieval, which is what BGE-M3 is in the stack for, and they
are labelled that way rather than as 'Hindi retrieval'.
Each Hindi query is a statement of the legal question at issue in one of the
derived queries, so THE GOLD ANSWER IS STILL A JUDGE'S. The English passage
was written by a court relying on that authority; only the language of the
asking changed. What we authored is the question, never the answer.
BNS/BNSS/BSA — five, and they are NOT WRITTEN. They need statute_mappings,
which Workstream C1 fills and which holds no rows yet. Ground truth for
'what replaced IPC s. 302' is a mapping row or it is a guess, and a guess is
exactly what DOMAIN_TRUTH.md forbids: no frontier model knows these codes.
They are declared here as pending so the runner reports the set as
INCOMPLETE rather than scoring 25 queries and calling it 30.

queries.query: क्या अभियुक्त से लिए गए हस्तलेख, हस्ताक्षर या अंगुली-छाप के नमूने अनुच्छेद 20(3) के अंतर्गत स्वयं के विरुद्ध साक्ष्य देने के लिए बाध्य करना माने जाएँगे? पुलिस अभिरक्षा में दिए गए कथन के संबंध में यह अनुमान नहीं लगाया जा सकता कि वह दबाव या यातना से प्राप्त किया गया था।

provenance.goldCase: THE STATE OF BOMBAY versus KATHI KALU OGHAD AND OTHERS
provenance.issue: Article 20(3) — whether compelled handwriting and fingerprint specimens are testimonial compulsion
provenance.authored: the question only; the gold answer remains the citation edge from the derived query

queries.query: निवारक निरोध के मामलों में 'लोक व्यवस्था' और 'विधि तथा व्यवस्था' के बीच क्या अंतर है? यदि यह दर्शाने के लिए कोई सामग्री नहीं है कि निरुद्ध व्यक्ति की गतिविधि से स्थानीय लोगों में आतंक फैला, तो निरोध आदेश की वैधता पर क्या प्रभाव पड़ेगा?

pending.why: Ground truth for a BNS/BNSS/BSA mapping question is a statute_mappings row or it is a guess. BNS/BNSS/BSA replaced IPC/CrPC/Evidence in July 2024 and no frontier model knows them (DOMAIN_TRUTH.md), so a hand-written gold answer here would be the exact failure the harness exists to detect, written into the harness.
